sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear zone (39 Fear Index) with neutral AAII sentiment; insufficient data to establish conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (281), rising dollar, and imminent FOMC decision creates severe risk environment for discretionary consumer stocks despite distant earnings.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend and hull bullish signals, RSI rising despite overbought levels, and market in fear zone creates contrarian entry opportunity for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI (78.71/78.1) with no volume confirmation (OBV not rising, weak CMF), weak ADX trend strength, imminent FOMC decision, inverted yield curve, crisis VIX, and rising dollar create severe macro headwinds that outweigh technical bullish structure.
